summary: GCL Global Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release about its subsidiary 4Divinity receiving a $9.0 million strategic investment from ADATA Technology, following prior investments totaling $23.0 million. The investment closed at $3.50 per share, implying a $350 million valuation for 4Divinity. Proceeds will fund acquisitions of game titles and platform development. The filing is routine disclosure of a subsidiary-level capital event, not a parent-level special situation.
